description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' used for serialization of reference types with surrogate support in Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing values, converting between surrogate and actual types, and references external serializers and codecs.

classes.name: GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing surrogate serialization support for reference types, implementing IFieldCodec and IDerivedTypeCodec interfaces.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the input, handling reference and surrogate deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField, writing reference or surrogate data as appropriate.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert surrogate type to the actual field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert the field type to its surrogate representation.
